title: AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to execute Modification No. 2 to Contract No. OP44851-20008370 with Prudential Overall Supply for uniform rental…
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0566, Contract]
[OPERATIONS, SAFETY, AND CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE COMMITTEE MADE THE FOLLOWING RECOMMENDATION (5-0):]
AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to execute Modification No. 2 to Contract No. OP44851-20008370 with Prudential Overall Supply for uniform rental services, to exercise the one, three-year option in the Not-To-Exceed (NTE) amount of $3,575,446, increasing the total contract NTE amount from $3,256,271 to $6,831,717, and extending the period of performance from December 1, 2026 to November 30, 2029.
summary: Authorizing a contract modification with Prudential Overall Supply to exercise a three-year option for uniform rental services, increasing the total contract amount from $3,256,271 to $6,831,717 through November 30, 2029.

details.action: Contract modification for uniform rental services
